repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-conversation
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin for the Webex conversation service. Registers webex.internal.conversation to create, read, and update conversations and activities, encrypts outbound and decrypts inbound conversation objects through KMS payload transforms, shares files through ShareActivity, and reads activities in thread order.

conversation-package-entry.summary: Published npm package @webex/internal-plugin-conversation. main resolves dist/index.js and devMain src/index.js; the entry registers the conversation internal plugin and exports the Conversation plugin as default plus ShareActivity, ConversationError, and InvalidUserCreation. Internal plugin without strict semver.

conversation-plugin-sdk.summary: The webex.internal.conversation method surface: conversation lifecycle, activity verbs, generated simple and tag verbs, reactions, activity reads, thread-ordered reads, realtime helpers, downloads, and URL helpers.

conversation-payload-transforms.summary: Payload-transformer predicates and normalize transforms registered with the plugin, plus the encryption and decryption transform sets from src/encryption-transforms.js and src/decryption-transforms.js appended on the host ready event according to config toggles.

conversation-share-activity.summary: ShareActivity builder: add, addGif, remove, getFiles, prepare, and the static create, uploading encrypted files and thumbnails to space upload sessions.

conversation-config.summary: Configuration defaults under webex.config.conversation: HTML tag/style allow-lists and process hooks, additional URL schemes, thumbnail limits, keepEncryptedProperties, decryptionFailureMessage, and the include decryption/encryption transform toggles.

conversation-service-http.source: Webex service-catalog service 'conversation' and per-conversation URLs resolved by getConvoUrl in src/conversation.js
conversation-service-http.summary: Upstream Webex conversation service consumed for conversations, activities, parents/children, mentions, threads, bulk fetch, typing status, and space URLs. Owned by the conversation service, not this repository.

files-upload-http.source: Space upload_sessions URLs returned by PUT <conversation url>/space and /space/hidden (src/share-activity.js)
files-upload-http.summary: Upstream files-service upload session API used for initialize, upload, and finalize phases of shared files and thumbnails.

webex-core-sdk.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module specs consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md and packages/@webex/webex-core/src/lib/services/docs/README.md; the no-op handling of unknown transform names is verified in packages/@webex/webex-core/src/webex-core.js)
webex-core-sdk.summary: WebexPlugin base, registerInternalPlugin, Page, request/upload, service catalog, and the payload-transformer engine.

webex-encryption-sdk.source: @webex/internal-plugin-encryption (workspace package; no SDD spec, code is the reference: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-encryption/src/encryption.js and src/kms.js)
webex-encryption-sdk.summary: KMS key creation including kms.createUnboundKeys, text/binary/SCR encryption and decryption, encrypted download, KMS message encryption, and unboundedStorage for reaction keys.

webex-user-sdk.summary: asUUID and recordUUID for participant identity.

webex-common-sdk.summary: proxyEvents, transferEvents, tap, patterns, and Exception.

helper-html-sdk.summary: filter (inbound) and filterEscape (outbound) used for content sanitization; in Node both return the input unparsed.

helper-image-sdk.summary: readExifData, detectFileType, and processImage used by download and ShareActivity.

artifact_decisions.reason: The package is a library plugin, not a deployable service; it declares no deployment descriptor, container, or runtime entry point.
The package serves no HTTP routes; it consumes the externally owned conversation and files services and publishes an SDK surface described by conversation-package-entry.
Security policy is owned at the webex-js-sdk repository root, not per package.
Contribution guidance is owned at the webex-js-sdk repository root and linked from README.md.
Changelog generation is owned at the monorepo root.
The CTO readiness workflow applies to deployable services; this package is a library.
Selected together with CTO_CHECKLIST.yml, which is omitted.
